problem_statement: The border router offers no way to manually control its OMR prefix: its handling is always automatic, with no option to disable OMR prefix publication or to publish a user-chosen prefix. Required behavior: the border router must expose an OMR configuration that can be set to one of three modes and read back. In the automatic mode it keeps auto-selecting the local OMR prefix; in a custom mode it uses a caller-supplied prefix together with its route preference; in a disabled mode it adds no local or delegated OMR prefix to the Thread network data. When a custom prefix is configured it must appear (with its preference) in the advertised Route Info Options and in the network data, and switching modes must correctly add, deprecate, or remove the affected prefix in subsequent RAs and network data. Selecting the custom mode with an invalid prefix must be rejected.
